items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: they had a big band on that show with Don Lamond was on drums

ctx.x: So I did a lot of performances on the “Little Rascals Show.” Okay? And you know they had a big band on that show with Don Lamond was on drums, they had a fantastic band. So Chubby hooked me up with his son, Duffy, and we started a little group together with Duffy. And then he got me a gig, my first big gig at eleven years old guesting with Bobby Hackett and Jack Teagarden. So I think that was my first big gig.
And what did you make? © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
